description: Book a task with a specific tasker. Set confirm=false to preview booking details, confirm=true to actually submit the booking. Must be logged in.

confirm.description: Set to true to actually submit the booking, false to just preview. Default is false.

description.description: Optional description of the task and any special requirements

location.description: Full address where the task will be performed (e.g., '123 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94102')

taskType.description: The type of task being booked (e.g., 'furniture assembly')

taskerId.description: The tasker's ID or username slug

name: taskrabbit_book_task
